newsitem.title: UK: European jet fuel weaker amid good supply.
newsitem.headline: European jet fuel weaker amid good supply.

text.p: European jet prices were unchanged to weaker on Tuesday, traders said.
Benchmark IPE gas oil futures offered little direction but, barge and cargo differentials to the futures screen were under some pressure amid good avails.
Barges valued around $1.50 lower at June IPE +$19 with trade reported between an airline and trade house at the level (equivalent to $192.75 a tonne) for 4kt lifting by the end of May fob Rotterdam.
Cargoes were talked June IPE +$19/$21 cif NWE $1-2 a tonne weaker.
